description:
NOTE: We tried YouTube's new "thumbnail creation" tool and we're putting it to an A/B test alongside our original thumb out of curiosity. Let's see which thumbnail wins!

Has Adam Savage ever been caught out attempting a DIY project instead of hiring a professional? Is there a career Adam would have explored or been curious about in a different life? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members Martin Hooker and Tenky, whom we thank for their support!
